fusions.name: Spore Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 4 spore clusters at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage and knocking the target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bowsprit Lance
fusions.desc: Thrusts a spore-tipped lance at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Downwind Puff
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Steady Keel
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
